svg.title: Which PHP checks a Nextcloud app
svg.desc: Renovate keeps the tools of composer.json current, with only the releases that run on the PHP of the tools, each major version on its own and PHPUnit below 13. The CI reads two versions of PHP from the files of the app: config.platform.php of composer.json, for which Composer locks the tools, and the min-version of the PHP in appinfo/info.xml, the oldest PHP that the app runs on. It sets up the oldest PHP first and the PHP of the tools last, so that php runs the tools. php-cs-fixer, Psalm for PHP 8.2 and PHPUnit in a new random order run on the PHP of the tools; then the step Oldest PHP parses the code that the app ships with php8.2 and checks that its packages install there.
